Name: Void's Weird Wonders - Wizard Furniture Recolor
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Ever thought that the Wizard Furniture was too brown and happy looking for your taste? It was lacking a more wizardry and dark look? Well, I've got some news for you then!

This mod retextures the furniture to fit more into the aesthetics of my other retextures that I like to call "Void's Weird Wonders". I tend to enjoy more goth-y and dark things in opposite to happy and cute and as this style usually lacks in mods here I am to bring my stuff to the folk! 

It comes in both CP and AT. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content PatcherAlternative Textures.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Generally Compatible. CP version is NOT compatible with other CP mods that edit the Wizard Furniture. AT version is A BIT NOT compatible with Polyamory because for some reason PolyAmory doesn't let you change the bed texture...otherwise it's fine.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3NSVKgHr/title2-1-see-also.png[/img]
